title: Multi Modal Transport Demand Forecasting
author: Siddhi Krishna Dabhade
description: This use case develops a multi-modal public transport demand forecasting system using real-world public transport datasets from London, Melbourne, NYC and NSW. The project standardises multiple transport datasets into a common time-series structure, engineers temporal and lag-based features, and applies machine learning and deep learning models to forecast passenger demand across transport modes such as buses, trains, trams and regional services. The analysis supports transport planning by identifying demand trends, comparing actual and predicted values, and generating high-demand indicators for dynamic scheduling decisions.
